node.title: Re: How do I make a tcp socket heartbeat?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I just noticed that your previous question from last week was in regards to [mod://AnyEvent]. Note that it is an event loop framework much like [mod://Mojo::IOLoop], so if you're already using one of them, it certainly can't hurt to learn about the others, but for your production code, you probably don't want to mix the two. See [mod://AnyEvent::Socket] for TCP servers and clients. (Personally I still prefer Mojo, and it can do Websockets too, but TIMTOWTDI.)
